title: Complete Web Development Bootcamp
instructorBio: Dr. Angela Yu is a developer and lead instructor with over 10 years of experience teaching web development. Her courses have helped over 1 million students launch their careers.
description: Learn HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frameworks. Build real-world projects.
longDescription: This course is designed for complete beginners and takes you from zero to a professional web developer. You will learn HTML5, CSS3, Flexbox, Grid, JavaScript ES6+, Node.js, React, MongoDB, and deployment. Every section includes hands-on projects so you can build a portfolio while you learn.
objectives: Build fully functional websites and web apps from scratch
Master HTML5, CSS3, and modern layout techniques
Write clean, professional JavaScript with ES6+ syntax
Build backend servers using Node.js and Express
Work with databases using MongoDB and SQL
Deploy projects to the web using Netlify and Heroku

reviews.name: James Carter
reviews.text: Absolutely the best web development course available. Angela explains everything clearly and the projects are genuinely fun to build. I landed my first dev job within 4 months of finishing.

reviews.name: Priya Sharma
reviews.text: I came in knowing nothing about coding. This course took me from complete beginner to confident developer. The progression is perfect and nothing feels rushed.

title: UI/UX Design Fundamentals
instructorBio: Sarah Johnson is a UX designer with 12 years of experience at top tech companies. She has designed products used by millions and now teaches the exact design process she uses professionally.
description: Master the principles of user interface and experience design. Learn Figma and design thinking.
longDescription: This course teaches you the complete UX design process from user research to high-fidelity prototypes. You will learn design thinking methodology, wireframing, Figma, typography, colour theory, and usability testing. By the end you will have a portfolio-ready case study.
objectives: Understand the full UX design process end to end
Conduct user research, interviews, and usability tests
Create wireframes and interactive prototypes in Figma
Apply typography, colour, and spacing principles
Design accessible and inclusive user interfaces
Build a complete UX case study for your portfolio

reviews.name: Aisha Patel
reviews.text: Sarah is an exceptional teacher. Her explanations of UX principles are clear, practical, and immediately applicable. My Figma skills improved dramatically in just two weeks.

reviews.name: Tom Richards
reviews.text: This is the most practical design course I have taken. Real projects, real feedback frameworks, and real Figma workflows. Worth every minute.

title: Machine Learning A-Z™
instructorBio: Kirill Eremenko is a data scientist with a background in physics and finance. He has taught over 1.2 million students worldwide and specialises in making complex ML concepts intuitive and accessible.
description: Learn to create ML algorithms from scratch. Master Python, R, and TensorFlow.
longDescription: This course covers machine learning from the ground up using both Python and R. You will learn regression, classification, clustering, association rule learning, reinforcement learning, natural language processing, and deep learning. Every algorithm is explained intuitively before being coded from scratch.
objectives: Build and evaluate regression and classification models
Apply clustering and association rule learning algorithms
Implement neural networks and deep learning with TensorFlow
Use both Python and R for data science workflows
Handle real-world datasets with feature engineering techniques
Deploy trained machine learning models to production

lessons.title: Types of ML: Supervised vs Unsupervised

reviews.name: Maria Chen
reviews.text: Outstanding course. Kirill explains complex ML concepts in an intuitive way before diving into code. The Python examples are production quality. I got a data scientist role 3 months after finishing.

reviews.name: David Kim
reviews.text: Best ML course available. Both Python and R implementations help you understand the concepts deeply rather than just copying code. Highly recommended for anyone serious about data science.

title: Digital Marketing Masterclass
instructorBio: Phil Ebiner has been teaching digital marketing for over 8 years. He has helped thousands of small businesses and entrepreneurs grow their online presence using proven, data-driven strategies.
description: Learn SEO, social media, email marketing, and analytics. Grow your business online.
longDescription: This comprehensive course covers every major digital marketing channel. You will learn SEO fundamentals, Google Ads, Facebook and Instagram advertising, email marketing automation, content marketing, and Google Analytics. Each module includes real campaign examples and actionable exercises.
objectives: Build an end-to-end digital marketing strategy
Rank websites higher in Google using proven SEO techniques
Run profitable paid advertising campaigns on Google and Meta
Build and automate email marketing sequences
Create and distribute content that drives organic traffic
Measure campaign performance using Google Analytics

reviews.name: Sophie Turner
reviews.text: I used to think marketing was just guesswork. This course completely changed my perspective. Phil's structured approach to campaigns made everything measurable and repeatable. Our website traffic doubled.

reviews.name: Carlos Mendez
reviews.text: Very thorough course covering all the major channels. The SEO and Google Ads sections are especially detailed. Would have liked more on TikTok but overall excellent value.

title: React - The Complete Guide
instructorBio: Maximilian Schwarzmüller is a professional web developer and instructor who has taught over 2 million students. He specialises in JavaScript frameworks and modern frontend development practices.
description: Master React.js with hooks, Redux, Next.js, and TypeScript. Build modern web apps.
longDescription: This is the most comprehensive React course available. You will learn React from scratch through to advanced patterns including hooks, context, Redux Toolkit, React Router, Next.js, and TypeScript. Every concept is taught through real projects including a complete e-commerce application.
objectives: Build complex React applications with confidence
Master React hooks including useState, useEffect, useContext
Manage global state with Redux Toolkit
Build server-side rendered apps with Next.js
Write type-safe React components with TypeScript
Test React components using React Testing Library

lessons.title: What is React and Why Use It?

reviews.name: Nathan Brooks
reviews.text: Max is simply the best React teacher. His explanations are methodical and the projects are genuinely challenging. I went from knowing basic JavaScript to building production React apps in three months.

reviews.name: Lin Wei
reviews.text: The hooks section alone is worth the entire course. Best structured learning path for React I have found anywhere. Updated regularly and always reflects current best practices.

title: Graphic Design Bootcamp
instructorBio: Lindsay Marsh is a professional graphic designer and art director with 15 years of experience working with global brands. She teaches practical design skills that translate directly to client work.
description: Learn Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign. Create stunning visual designs.
longDescription: This bootcamp teaches you professional graphic design using the industry-standard Adobe Creative Suite. You will master Photoshop for photo editing and compositing, Illustrator for vector graphics and logos, and InDesign for print and digital layouts. Real-world client briefs are used throughout.
objectives: Edit and retouch photos professionally in Adobe Photoshop
Create logos and vector artwork in Adobe Illustrator
Design print and digital publications in Adobe InDesign
Understand colour theory, typography, and layout principles
Build a professional design portfolio from scratch
Deliver client-ready design files in correct formats

reviews.name: Emma Davis
reviews.text: Lindsay makes design approachable for beginners without dumbing anything down. I started with zero design experience and now take on freelance projects. The portfolio section was particularly valuable.

reviews.name: Raj Patel
reviews.text: Very comprehensive for all three Adobe tools. Photoshop and Illustrator sections are excellent. Would appreciate more advanced InDesign content but overall a great starting point.

title: Deep Learning Specialization
instructorBio: Andrew Ng is one of the world's leading AI researchers, co-founder of Coursera, and former head of AI at Google and Baidu. His courses have introduced millions of students to machine learning and deep learning.
description: Master neural networks, CNNs, RNNs, and transformers. Build AI applications from scratch.
longDescription: This specialization covers the foundations of deep learning with rigorous mathematical intuition and practical TensorFlow implementations. Topics include neural network architecture, convolutional networks for vision, sequence models for NLP, and transformer architectures. Each course concludes with a capstone project.
objectives: Build and train deep neural networks from scratch
Apply convolutional networks to image recognition tasks
Implement recurrent networks and LSTMs for sequence data
Understand and apply transformer architectures
Tune hyperparameters and optimise model performance
Deploy deep learning models in real applications

reviews.name: Yuki Tanaka
reviews.text: Andrew Ng has a rare gift for making complex mathematics feel intuitive. This is the definitive deep learning course. I have read textbooks on the subject but nothing built my understanding as well as this.

reviews.name: Omar Hassan
reviews.text: Every AI engineer should take this course. The theory is rigorous and the implementations are practical. Andrew explains the why behind every architectural decision, not just the how.

title: Social Media Marketing 2024
instructorBio: Ben Simmons has managed social media for brands with audiences of over 10 million followers. He specialises in organic growth strategies and paid social advertising across all major platforms.
description: Master Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and LinkedIn. Grow your brand and audience.
longDescription: This course covers the organic and paid strategies for every major social media platform. You will learn content strategy, community management, influencer marketing, paid social advertising, and how to analyse your results. Platform-specific modules are updated every quarter to reflect algorithm changes.
objectives: Build a consistent brand presence across all major platforms
Create content strategies that drive engagement and growth
Run profitable paid campaigns on Instagram and Facebook
Grow a LinkedIn presence for B2B lead generation
Leverage TikTok trends and short-form video content
Measure ROI using platform analytics and third-party tools

reviews.name: Jessica Park
reviews.text: Ben's course is completely up to date, which is rare for social media education. His Instagram growth strategies got our account from 2K to 18K followers in two months.

reviews.name: Alex Thompson
reviews.text: Great coverage of Instagram and Facebook. The TikTok section could be deeper but everything else is excellent. Very practical with real-world campaign examples throughout.

title: Python for Data Science
instructorBio: Jose Portilla is a data scientist and Python trainer with a background in mathematics and statistics. He has trained thousands of professionals at companies including Google, Tesla, and Citibank.
description: Learn NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, and scikit-learn. Analyze data and build ML models.
longDescription: This course teaches Python specifically for data analysis and machine learning. You will master NumPy for numerical computing, Pandas for data manipulation, Matplotlib and Seaborn for visualisation, and scikit-learn for machine learning. Every topic is reinforced with real datasets and end-to-end projects.
objectives: Write clean, efficient Python code for data analysis
Manipulate and clean datasets using Pandas DataFrames
Perform numerical computing with NumPy arrays
Visualise data insights using Matplotlib and Seaborn
Build and evaluate machine learning models with scikit-learn
Work with real-world datasets from Kaggle and public APIs

reviews.name: Fatima Al-Rashid
reviews.text: Jose's teaching style is perfect for someone who knows Python basics but wants to apply it to data science. The Pandas sections are incredibly thorough and the real dataset projects solidify everything.

reviews.name: Lucas Oliveira
reviews.text: This course bridges the gap between Python programming and data science beautifully. The scikit-learn module is particularly strong. I felt confident entering Kaggle competitions after completing it.

title: MBA Essentials for Everyone
instructorBio: Chris Haroun is an award-winning professor, venture capitalist, and former Goldman Sachs employee. He has an MBA from Columbia University and has taught business to over 1 million students worldwide.
description: Learn business strategy, finance, and management. Essential MBA concepts simplified.
longDescription: This course distils the most valuable lessons from a full MBA programme into 40 accessible hours. Topics include corporate strategy, financial modelling, accounting, leadership, operations, and entrepreneurship. Real case studies from Apple, Amazon, Tesla, and Google are used throughout.
objectives: Develop and evaluate business strategies using proven frameworks
Read and interpret financial statements confidently
Build basic financial models in Excel or Google Sheets
Apply leadership and management principles in the workplace
Understand operations, supply chain, and project management
Evaluate startup ideas using venture capital frameworks

reviews.name: Michael O'Brien
reviews.text: This course genuinely delivers MBA-level content without the MBA price tag. Chris makes complex financial concepts accessible without oversimplifying. The case study approach keeps every lesson grounded in reality.

reviews.name: Ananya Singh
reviews.text: Excellent breadth of content. The strategy and finance modules are outstanding. Some operations sections could go deeper but for an overview of MBA concepts this is the best course available.

title: Advanced UX Research Methods
instructorBio: Emma Williams is a lead UX researcher with experience at Microsoft and Spotify. She specialises in mixed-method research, usability testing, and translating user insights into measurable product improvements.
description: Master user research techniques, A/B testing, and usability studies. Data-driven design.
longDescription: This advanced course is for designers and product managers who want to make research-backed decisions. You will learn ethnographic research, diary studies, tree testing, A/B testing, statistical significance, and how to present findings to stakeholders. Suitable for teams following design sprints or continuous discovery.
objectives: Plan and execute comprehensive user research programmes
Conduct moderated and unmoderated usability studies
Design statistically valid A/B and multivariate tests
Analyse qualitative data using affinity mapping and thematic analysis
Communicate research findings to engineering and product teams
Integrate research into agile and continuous discovery workflows

reviews.name: Hannah Lee
reviews.text: Finally a research course that goes beyond the basics. Emma covers statistical significance in A/B testing in a way that is actually understandable for designers. Changed how our entire team approaches research.

reviews.name: Daniel Kowalski
reviews.text: The most rigorous UX research course I have found. Emma's real-world examples from enterprise products make the content immediately applicable. Essential for anyone moving into senior design or product roles.

title: Full-Stack JavaScript Developer
instructorBio: Brad Traversy is one of the most respected web development educators online. He has been teaching practical, project-based programming for over a decade and his courses are known for being direct, clear, and genuinely useful.
description: Build complete web apps with Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and React. End-to-end development.
longDescription: This course teaches you to build production-ready full-stack applications using the JavaScript ecosystem. You will work with Node.js and Express on the backend, MongoDB with Mongoose for the database, and React on the frontend. The course concludes with a complete full-stack project with authentication and deployment.
objectives: Build RESTful APIs with Node.js and Express
Design and query MongoDB databases using Mongoose
Implement JWT authentication and authorisation
Build reactive frontend interfaces with React
Connect frontend and backend with fetch and Axios
Deploy full-stack applications to cloud platforms

reviews.name: Ivan Petrov
reviews.text: Brad is the best project-based teacher I have encountered. No fluff, no filler — just building real things and learning why each piece works. I rebuilt my portfolio after finishing this and got three job interviews.

reviews.name: Grace Okonkwo
reviews.text: This course filled every gap in my full-stack knowledge. The authentication section is particularly strong and the final project is genuinely deployable. Brad's code is clean and the explanations are precise.
